race.comment: STREET CHASE (7) went straight the front here last time and never looked like getting run down. The rise in trip is perhaps a slight query but he draws well again for Graham and has more up his sleeve fourth-up. NOBLE DECREE (6) beat STREET CHASE first-up three weeks ago at Eagle Farm, and his two wins and a placing from three starts at this distance bode well for the rise to 1350m. LORD OF BISCAY (2) hasn't shown much this prep but drops from stakes company and has a good record at this trip. Inside draw could go either way for him but if he brings his best he'll be in the finish. LEG DRIVE (1) best of the rest.
